youtube.title: Why Light Bulbs Are Filled With Gas 💡 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
An incandescent bulb heats a thin tungsten filament to roughly 2,500 degrees Celsius. In ordinary air the hot metal would react with oxygen and burn up almost instantly. Early bulbs used a vacuum, but the filament slowly evaporated, so manufacturers switched to inert argon gas, which slows that evaporation and extends the bulb's life.
